# CXG (Customer Experience Group)

> > CXG is a global luxury customer experience consultancy specializing in CX transformation, mystery shopping, retail training, and NPS programs for premium brands.

With offices in Dubai, Hong Kong, London, Melbourne, and Paris, CXG partners with luxury brands like Montblanc, Gucci, and Tiffany & Co. to elevate client-centricity through evaluation programs (CXE), Academy training, and strategic consulting. The firm combines voice-of-customer insights with omnichannel retail transformation to help luxury brands deliver exceptional experiences.

## Key Topics

- Luxury retail customer experience
- CX transformation and consulting
- Mystery shopping and CXE programs
- NPS (Net Promoter Score) tracking
- Retail training and Academy workshops
- Client-centricity and clienteling
- Omnichannel luxury retail
- Voice of customer insights
- CRM integration
- Sales skills development
- Luxury brand partnerships (Montblanc, Gucci, Tiffany & Co.)
- Global operations (Dubai, Paris, Hong Kong)
- Retail Signature design
- Customer experience evaluation

## Core Services & Capabilities

- [Beratung und Transformation im Bereich Kundenerlebnis - CXG](https://www.cxg.com/de/capability/beratung-und-umgestaltung): CXG consulting & CX transformation services tailored to client goals
- [NPS Pulse](https://www.cxg.com/capability/nps-pulse): NPS Pulse: tailored Net Promoter Score programs for luxury CX strategy
- [Programa CXE - CXG](https://www.cxg.com/es/programa-cxe): CXE Program: Customer Experience Evaluation across brand touchpoints
- [Valutatori CX | Mystery Shopping | Cliente misterioso - CXG](https://www.cxg.com/it/valutatori): CXG CX evaluators: mystery shopping community for luxury brands
